tracking_policy: Preserve the already-computed body_first_v001 IDs exactly. Do not rerun or modify tracking.
row_policy: Retain every raw prediction, including null-ID/unassigned detections. accepted_for_tracking selects the assigned-only view.
water_policy: Preserve and independently verify existing Shell-point membership in the accepted fixed polygon; boundary included, no uncertainty band.
missing_float_policy: Normalize serialized NaN measurements to Arrow null; preserve other numeric values and every source observation.
